Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Article.name: Article
Article.comment: An article whose summary a model writes from its body, with no review.

ArticleDerivedDerivations.name: ArticleDerivedDerivations
ArticleDerivedDerivations.comment: On a table, one row per derived field of the row, keyed by the field's name: the hash its value is derived under, the hash of its last settled value with its model, confidence, settler and time, the override a write gave it, its failed attempts and last failure, and whether rederive forced it. Every write of the row keeps them in line; a delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: article
fields.description: The Article row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: field
fields.description: The derived field's name.

fields.name: sourceHash
fields.description: The SHA-256 of the model label, the instruction, the output schema and the inputs that hold a value; absent while no input holds one.

fields.name: settledHash
fields.description: The source hash of the last value settled; absent before the first.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model label the last value was settled under.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: The confidence the last value was settled with, from 0 to 1.

fields.name: settledAt
fields.description: When the last value was settled, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: settledBy
fields.description: The subject of the deriver that settled it.

fields.name: overriddenBy
fields.description: Who wrote the field over Derived: a caller's subject, another behavior's name, or existing for a value the row held before; absent until one does and after rederive.

fields.name: overriddenAt
fields.description: When the override was written, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: The failed attempts since the source hash last moved or a value settled.

fields.name: failure
fields.description: The last failure a deriver settled: { class?, message }.

fields.name: forced
fields.description: Whether rederive asked for the field again while its hash had not moved.

Ticket.name: Ticket
Ticket.comment:
A support ticket a model triages (D73, D103's step 4): its category and
priority are derived from its subject and body by a deriver holding
tickets.derive, each answer recorded with the confidence the model gave,
and an answer below 0.8 proposed until a reviewer holding tickets.review
accepts or rejects it. A ticket moves to assigned only once both are out
of review.

priority.instruction: How urgent is this? low, normal or high.

fields.name: provenanceInReview
fields.description: Whether any recorded field is proposed. A list filters on it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

TicketProvenanceRecords.name: TicketProvenanceRecords
TicketProvenanceRecords.comment: On a table, one row per recorded field of the row, keyed by the field's name: the last write's source, who made it and for whom, when, the confidence its attribution gave, and its review. Every write of the row keeps them in line; a delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: ticket
fields.description: The Ticket row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: field
fields.description: The recorded field's name.

fields.name: source
fields.description: caller for a caller's create or update, else the name of the behavior whose operation wrote it.

fields.name: bySubject
fields.description: The subject of the caller whose write it records.

fields.name: forSubject
fields.description: The subject the caller acted for (D77); absent when it acted for no one.

fields.name: writtenAt
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: The confidence the write's attribution gave, from 0 to 1.

fields.name: review
fields.description: proposed, accepted, rejected or edited; absent for a write that entered no review.

fields.name: reviewedBy
fields.description: The subject of the reviewer, or of the caller whose write edited a proposal.

fields.name: reviewedAt
fields.description: When the review settled, in epoch milliseconds.
